title: festuca rubens
intro: Festuca rubens, commonly known as red fescue, is a type of perennial grass native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, as it is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca rubens include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
